services.name: Cabin 5
services.desc: Do you prefer to “camp indoors” or stay in an air conditioned cabin? Well, then take a look at the following list of cabins. All of our cabins are overlooking the Guadalupe River. Camp Huaco offers these cabins as an alternative to our tent camping or RV Park. We have three cabins located on property just above the Rockin’ R outfit. Our cabins are free standing, basic living, and sleep between 2 and 8 people. Cabins include fitted sheets, flat sheets, pillows and pillowcases, but no blankets or comforters, towels, dishes, cookware, or cooking utensils.
